searchText: For proposer preferences, we would sign using a different leaf index, so it should be fine Hm so if the dependent root changes, then builders don't ignore the different proposer preference I think you just don't send them, dependent root can only change under non-finality. At any rate, block proposals and proposer preferences both of them can have a dedicated set of leaves that grow by a counter since they are not likely to happen often. they can both share the same set of leaves, with an offset 0 for proposals and offset 1 for preferences same with the payload for self-building as well if we keep that signature (although I believe we should go with Cayman's idea and just remove this signature)
